title: Node-splitting and design-by-treatment inconsistency in the browser: validation against the R package netmeta
description: Current source allmeta v1.8.0 (tag commit 1cb3f8409c7af75ed41f7e1811f9c502f900fc79; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23515177); PR heads #143 0bea27b258fe73a1f7a1dbd90693c5ce7a8eb4b9, #160 dd9f2a863dffc0f34f715442f1698633cfb133a2. Node captures of the v1.8.0 page against the archived netmeta reference: 76601/76601 primary and 319/319 focused checks pass; leave-one-study-out panel replay 643413/643413; plus browser tier re-run on the v1.8.0 bytes (Microsoft Edge 155): 42/42 tests pass, including the v1.8.0 behaviour that invalid input clears results. Historical evidence: Node-splitting and design-by-treatment validation of the allmeta nma-inconsistency page against R netmeta 3.7.0 (FE/DL/PM, 540 configurations; original 79869/83592, patched 76601/76601 checks pass). Source commit 7966530de875d22253f0557c7b447ed9d917685d plus fix.patch; fixes merged in PR #143 (merge commit acdb28371560a797eb256c591edb5969d4675f62).
